authorization: The owner requested a more elegant zodiac selection treatment after the approved live option C release: "i don’t like the box around the zodiac when you select it, looks sloppy. there must be a more elegant animation or design." This follow-up replaces the selected box with a fine circular ring and restrained motion, retains immediate keyboard/reduced-motion feedback, updates existing visual checks, and synchronizes generated shared wing styles. Selection logic, data, artwork and transaction behavior are unchanged.
